name_zh: 费利克斯/科特迪瓦/稳定：资源诅咒缓解与出口导向建国
name_en: Felix/Ivory Coast/Stability: Resource Curse Mitigation & Export-Oriented Nation-Building
description_zh: 费利克斯·乌弗埃-博瓦尼 (1905-1993) 科特迪瓦首任总统 (1960-1993)/可可/咖啡/木材/出口导向/法资/政治稳定/阿比让奇迹/亚穆苏克罗/大教堂/1990 多党/经济危机/1999 政变/2002-2011 内战/瓦塔拉/乌弗埃遗产/后殖民/法语非洲/建国。核心建国逻辑：出口农业/法资绑定/稳定优先/基建显性/资源诅咒缓解。体现 M168 资源诅咒缓解 — 以"出口农业+法资深度绑定+政治稳定+基建显性"四位一体，在单一作物/法语非洲/冷战/内战四重约束中实现相对繁荣与稳定。
description_en: Felix Houphouet-Boigny (1905-1993) Côte d'Ivoire first President (1960-1993)/cocoa/coffee/timber/export-oriented/French capital/political stability/Abidjan miracle/Yamoussoukro/basilica/1990 multi-party/crisis/1999 coup/2002-2011 civil war/Ouattara/Houphouet-Boigny legacy/post-colonial/Francophone Africa/nation-building. Core nation-building logic: export agriculture/French capital deep binding/stability priority/infrastructure visibility/resource curse mitigation. Exemplifies M168 Resource Curse Mitigation — quaternity of 'export agriculture + French capital binding + political stability + visible infrastructure' achieving relative prosperity & stability amid quadruple constraints of single crop/Francophone Africa/Cold War/civil war.
reason_zh: 乌弗埃非单纯建国者，而是"可可外交+法资共生+稳定优先"三位一体务实建国者。以可可/咖啡换法资/技术/市场/安全，以政治稳定换经济增长/外资信心/区域领袖地位。M168 区隔于 M169 后石油转型(沙特)、M171 资源民族主义(委内瑞拉)、M189 大人制(蒙博图)，核心在于"出口农业+外资共生+稳定优先"的法语非洲务实建国范式。
reason_en: Houphouet-Boigny not mere nation-builder but 'cocoa diplomacy + French capital symbiosis + stability first' trinity pragmatic builder. Traded cocoa/coffee for French capital/tech/markets/security, traded political stability for growth/FDI confidence/regional leadership. M168 distinct from M169 Post-Oil (Saudi), M171 Resource Nationalist (Venezuela), M189 Big Man (Mobutu), core: 'export agriculture + foreign capital symbiosis + stability first' Francophone Africa pragmatic nation-building paradigm.
